title: SRM Resting-state EEG
description: This dataset contains four-minute eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings extracted from the Stimulus-Selective Response Modulation (SRM) project paradigm at the University of Oslo. It includes 64-channel BioSemi recordings from 111 healthy control participants at a first session (t1), with a subset re-recorded at a later session (t2). Raw data are provided with a fully automated cleaned derivative, along with demographic and cognitive test scores.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system using 64 electrodes placed according to the extended 10-20 (10-10) system. Each recording comprises four minutes of continuous, unfiltered eyes-closed resting-state data, rereferenced to the average reference. A cleaned derivative was produced with a basic automated preprocessing pipeline, in which bad channels were interpolated.
